title: A massive 7T fMRI dataset to bridge cognitive and computational neuroscience (preprint title; published as 'A massive 7T fMRI dataset to bridge cognitive neuroscience and artificial intelligence')
authors: Emily J. Allen, Ghislain St-Yves, Yihan Wu, Jesse L. Breedlove, Logan T. Dowdle, Brad Caron, Franco Pestilli, Ian Charest, J. Benjamin Hutchinson, Thomas Naselaris, Kendrick Kay
venue: bioRxiv 2021.02.22.432340 (preprint, posted 22 February 2021); published version: Nature Neuroscience 25, 116-126 (2022)
caption_short: Trial design of the NSD continuous recognition task: while holding central fixation, participants see a stream of COCO natural scenes (3 s on, 1 s off, 8.4 degrees visual angle) and report for each image whether they have seen it before at any point in the experiment.
notes: The published Nature Neuroscience version is paywalled, is NOT deposited in PubMed Central (checked via the PMC ID converter and Europe PMC; no author manuscript exists), and Unpaywall reports no open-access location for 10.1038/s41593-021-00962-x. The CC BY 4.0 bioRxiv preprint was therefore used; its Figure 1A corresponds to Figure 1a of the published article. Crop is panel A only (panels B-D and the caption are excluded). Because panel B's letter label and 'Stimulus trials' text overlap panel A's bounding box horizontally, the top-right corner region of the crop (which contains no panel A content) was filled with white; this is equivalent to a non-rectangular crop of panel A and removes no panel A material. bioRxiv rate-limits/challenges direct downloads; the PDF eventually downloaded on retry and is saved as site/papers/nsd.pdf. Rendered at 440 dpi because the panel is physically small on the page (final crop 765x745 px).
